dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lawaia told me your fish are the freshest in town.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: Haha, that kid knows his stuff. Guess I made the right choice hiring him.

dialogues.speaker: Teuciztli
dialogues.text: And judging by how you chose to eat with us, it seems like you know your stuff as well. Here you go, these are for you.
